title: Secondtake Registration
description: Pre-declared change registration consumed by `secondtake compare --registration`.

change.description: Single-line description of the setup change under evaluation.

margins.description: Non-negative regression margins. Omitted keys use defaults (10, 10, 1, 5).

cost_pct.description: Maximum allowed relative increase in mean token cost (percent).

time_pct.description: Maximum allowed relative increase in mean wall duration (percent).

rework_per_pair.description: Maximum allowed absolute increase in mean redo moments per pair.

rescue_points.description: Maximum allowed percentage-point drop in rescue rate.

min_pairs.description: Minimum matched pairs required before issuing keep, tune, or revert (must be written in plain JSON integer syntax without decimal point or exponent).
